notes: This initial catalog contains 134 named NPC/person pages from the Endfield Fandom NPC category when checked. The catalog page explicitly describes its list as incomplete, so this snapshot does not assert a complete official NPC roster.
Rossi and Tangtang were excluded because the current official operator directory classifies them as Operators.

English, Simplified Chinese, and Vietnamese values were cross-checked against matching localization values or aligned in-game text in the extracted client-data mirror. Confidence is B because the evidence is an unofficial mirror of official client localization rather than a first-party NPC directory.

Hán-Việt names were generated character by character from the verified Simplified Chinese names with the Thi Viện Hán-Nôm dictionary. Context-sensitive readings were selected only from alternatives returned by that dictionary. These are search aliases, not official Vietnamese localization, and have confidence E.
M3 and TA-TA have no Han characters to convert. The dictionary returned no reading for 菈 in 米菈, so Mila remains unresolved rather than receiving a guessed Hán-Việt alias.
Thumbnail URLs are community-catalog discovery references only. They are not treated as first-party name evidence or bundled module assets.
